businesses.business: aerospace and defense, power and industrial engineered products

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures highly engineered components, subsystems and systems for aerospace, defense, naval nuclear power, commercial power and general industrial customers. Sells mainly to defense prime contractors, the US Navy and other governments, commercial aircraft makers and utilities. Products are made in its own plants and supported with aftermarket and engineering services.

primary_products.value: naval propulsion pumps, valves and reactor components; flight control actuators and avionics; defense electronics and embedded computing; industrial valves and actuation; surface treatment

primary_services.value: aftermarket repair and maintenance; engineering and design services; metal surface treatment services; nuclear plant refurbishment support

customer_segment.value: B2B: defense primes, aircraft manufacturers, utilities, nuclear plant operators, industrial and process companies; B2G: US Navy, Department of Defense and allied defense ministries

end_markets.value: naval defense; aerospace; ground and air defense; commercial nuclear power; general industrial

revenue_model.value: product sales: engineered components, subsystems and electronics sold to defense and commercial customers; project or contract: long-term government and prime contractor programs, including naval nuclear contracts; service fees: aftermarket repair, surface treatment and engineering support
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds engineered components and subsystems from metals and electronics, sold to primes and governments; component supplier: supplies parts and subsystems to aircraft, ship and plant builders; service provider: repairs, upgrades and treats parts for installed equipment
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; service provider

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus Canada, the UK, Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: defense electronics, naval systems, aerospace controls, commercial power and industrial valves built on shared engineering

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to primes, Navy, governments, utilities and OEMs; distributors / dealers: some industrial valve and aftermarket sales through distributors and agents

regulatory_exposure.value: high: defense and naval nuclear work under DoD, DCMA, NRC, FAA, export controls (ITAR) and security clearances
